lines: [intrigued, cinematic] What if the internet went DOWN... [short pause] for one WHOLE day?

[serious, revealing] It already HAPPENED. [short pause] In twenty twenty-two, [short pause] TWELVE MILLION Canadians lost their phones and internet. [short pause] DEBIT cards stopped working across the country.
[slower, ominous] Now imagine... [short pause] the WHOLE world.
[storytelling, a bit eerie] You wake up. [short pause] No messages. [short pause] No news. [short pause] No maps.
[deadpan] You tap your card. [pause] [clearly, flat] Declined. [short pause] Cash only.
[urgent] Offices FREEZE. [short pause] Email, [short pause] video calls, [short pause] cloud files: [short pause] GONE.
[urgent, building] Airports go into CHAOS. [short pause] In twenty twenty-four, [short pause] one bad software update cancelled over FIVE THOUSAND flights [short pause] in a single day.
[fast, punchy] No deliveries. [short pause] No rides. [short pause] No streaming.
[slow, dramatic] And the bill... [short pause] for ONE day?
[warm, playful, challenging] So, [short pause] could YOU survive a day offline? [short pause] Comment below!
